page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The x86_64 architecture instance provides 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated CPU allocation model ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention from other tenants, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring predictable CPU execution. The balanced 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio makes this instance suitable for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and moderate database hosting.
